summary.interpretative_mandate: Detected anomalies represent unusual rate-of-change spikes in housing price index valuations. They serve as triggers for multi-domain verification, NOT automated labels of neighborhood transformation.

anomalies.description: Quarterly growth of 14.85% on 2012-09-30 deviated significantly from the preceding 8-quarter average (5.57% ± 4.03%), Z = 2.3.
anomalies.caveat: This price fluctuation reflects unusual valuation velocity in official assessment records. It does NOT independently prove gentrification or tenant displacement.
